thread:
maria: deploy-bot flagged a surge in embeddings worker OOMs in eu-west1. Need quick approval to push a hotfix (v2.3.2). brief: memory cap growth under burst traffic. Can we expedite a canary? @duty-officer 

deploy-bot: ALERT: embeddings-service eu-west1: 5xx rate x5, OOM count 42 in last 5m. Suggested action: release v2.3.2 (hotfix) -> image redwood/embeddings:2.3.2-hotfix. Recommended canary 5% -> 100%.

chris: repro steps / logs?

maria: logs attached to PR, stack traces point at tensor allocator growth after quant change. Short fix: revert allocator tweak + bump mem limit. PR #889 with patch and release note draft: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/889

jamal: oncall here — we are inside change window, ~1.5h left. I can lead the rollout. +1 for expedited canary.

leo: we should pin v2.3.2 to dedicated eu-west1 pool to avoid cross-traffic during recovery. Ops, can we reserve slots?

kat: infra ack: can reserve 3 dedicated instances in eu-west1. Will disable autoscale for the window.

maria: release note (draft): "Fix memory growth in embeddings-service causing OOM under burst; revert allocator heuristic; increase mem limit." Added to PR description.

chris: quick E2E: `make test-e2e EMB_REGION=eu-west1 --filter embeddings` — I can run it now, ~6m.

jamal: running e2e now, will report in 10.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY REQUEST: user=maria, action=canary-rollout, image=redwood/embeddings:2.3.2-hotfix, fraction=5%, region=eu-west1. Requires approvals: duty-officer, infra, se.

leo: se ack. smoke on staging looked good. +1 from me.

jamal: e2e passed, no OOMs observed in 15m. logs look healthy.

duty-officer: approved for 5% canary. proceed and monitor.

deploy-bot: Canary started. 5% traffic -> OK. Telemetry: OOMs=0 in canary (15m), latency within SLA. Scheduling increase to 25% in 10m unless rollback requested.

chris: I'll keep an eye on KV-cache hit ratio and p95 latency; posting alerts to this thread if anything looks off.

maria: holding at 25% for 15m after the bump, then fast-roll to 100% if stable. I'll update changelog and release notes.

deploy-bot: ROLLFORWARD DECISION WINDOW: Voting closes in 10m. React with :thumbsup: to fast-track to 100% after 25% holds stable.

leo: :+1: fast-track.

kat: :+1: infra green.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — prepping final notes.

deploy-bot: Fast-track logged. Target: 100% rollout in 30m assuming no regressions. Final status will be posted here.
